notes: All data retrieved 2026-11-01 from official Université de Montréal pages only. Students must confirm dates and course lists with the Faculté de médecine dentaire (StudiUM / Centre étudiant).

D.M.D. follows a faculty-specific calendar that differs from the general UdeM calendar: classes start the week of 2026-08-17 (general: 2026-09-01), there is no fall reading week for D.M.D. (general: 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25 'dans certaines unités'), and 4th-year students have a summer term (intensive courses and clinical/research internship).
The registrar's calendars page does not list Médecine dentaire among faculties with their own calendar, but the faculty publishes one on its Infos académiques page.
Exam periods are not published for D.M.D.; exam schedules are communicated at the start of each term by the Vice-décanat aux études et affaires étudiantes.

credits = academic credits ('crédit académique', counted in the student record). The faculty course lists also show 'crédits progressifs' (billing/status), which differ for split courses (e.g. x.1 / x.2 pairs where the .1 part has 0 academic credits).
semester: 1 = automne (A), 2 = hiver (H), 3 = été (E). programYear 1-5 (the program is 5 years; the requested 1-4 range does not cover year 5).
Course lists by year PDFs are undated on their face; they were linked from the faculty Infos académiques page on 2026-11-01 alongside the 2026-2027 calendar.
English course titles: none are officially published on the pages consulted; title_en is null for every course.
